```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "likert2a"


df <- load_filtered_tf(plot_countries)
likert_cols <- question_columns(question_code, names(df))
```

## `r filter_label`

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(FILTER)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  levels = likert_frequency_levels(),
  empty_message = paste0("No responses available for ", filter_label, " in the current filter.")
)
```

### Statistics by age group

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(FILTER)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  group_by = "age_group",
  include_plot = FALSE,
  heading_level = 4L,
  levels = likert_frequency_levels(),
  empty_message = paste0("No responses available for ", filter_label, " in the current filter.")
)
```
